about_the_game:
《Fluffy Kitchen Saga》 is a restaurant simulation game at the bottom of your screen. Manage your diner while working/studying/handling tasks. Serve fluffy customers dishes to earn coins, upgrade recipes, and unlock new fluffy patrons. Relaxing gameplay where fluffies accompany you daily~

This game features N+ themed scenes where you can unlock corresponding decorative furniture items such as dining tables, stools, cashier counters, dessert stations, coffee bars, decorations, carpets, and more! With over 50+ craftable dishes, numerous highly experienced restaurant staff, and 4 mysterious customer groups totaling 100+ characters, plus multiple interactive mini-games to enjoy!

♥Gameplay♥

  • Serve Customers: Welcome various adorable furry customers into your restaurant—kittens, puppies, bunnies, and more! They’re all super cute and fluffy. Feel free to poke them if you’re curious...

  • Unlock Dishes: Over 50+ delicious dishes (global cuisines, desserts, milk tea) are waiting to be unlocked! Serve customers, earn coins, upgrade your dishes, and attract even more fluffy new guests!

  • Theme Unlocks: Time to unlock new themes! Gain access to adorable new customers and decorative furniture to style up your restaurant.

  • Restaurant Staff: Your team is made up of highly skilled professionals: leopards, front desk attendants, receptionists, cleaners, chefs, and promoters. With their help, your restaurant will thrive—clean environment, tasty food, and happy customers!

  • Special Feature: Daily Fortune Draw: Draw a fortune to see your luck for the day—will it be "Small Blessing: Meme Guardian Protection" or "Good Luck Today! Reverse Mercury Retrograde"?

  • Enjoy Music: The in-game jukebox lets you play music! Discover what your fluffy customers are listening to every day.

  • Mini-Games: Take a break from managing your restaurant and enjoy mini-games like Blackjack, Food Fusion, and more (stay tuned!).

    P.S. Additional features are under development—stay excited!

P.S. If you enjoy casual & management sims, this game is for you (the world needs adorable fluffies~).

Languages: Simplified&Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese.
